headline: Stalled-projects fix — now reads every workspace shape cleanly + handles every project status.

items.prompt_template: Quick bugfix on the stalled-projects detector. The first version only worked on workspaces with an older data shape — most workspaces use the newer one and got zero results. Now I read both, use each project's own last-activity timestamp as the primary signal, and handle every project status (active, exploring, paused, blocked, dormant, archived — the prior version only knew three). If you already configured stalled-projects, your settings carry forward. Say `change my stall settings` to add thresholds for the new statuses, or `show me stalled projects` to run the fixed detector.
